coordinates: frozen Smooth(alpha 0.5) + saved signs + H128 from the C8 source banks (loss-pair calibration.bank_directory), Cayley U = I; same code path as the historical H_W16A4 arm (rotation_bank.transformed with zero rotations)
weights: original BF16 weights transformed once into the same coordinates and cast to BF16; no weight quantization in D1/D3

quantizer.grid: symmetric absmax per token (optionally per 32-channel group), round half-to-even, clamp +-(2^(b-1)-1), FP32 dequant, BF16 operand; b=4 without groups is bitwise rotation_bank.A4
quantizer.cross_step: per (Linear, input shape) state within one query: innovation Delta_s = z_s - xhat_{s-1}; feedback v_s = Delta_s + h w_{s-1}; q_s = Q(v_s); w_s = q_s - v_s; xhat_s = xhat_{s-1} + q_s; operand xhat_s
quantizer.static_inputs: an input bitwise equal to the previous call of the same key reuses that call's operand (what the deployed condition cache does for context K/V and text embedding)
quantizer.dither: non-subtractive RPDF dither U[-0.5,0.5) LSB added before rounding; CUDA generator seeded dither_seed + 10*case + seed_index per query
quantizer.prefill: video-stream call index 10 (the single conditioning pass on the clean future) can use prefill_bits; video head is only called 10 times
quantizer.action_bits: action-expert Linears use action_bits when set; proprio encoder follows bits

d1.forward: BF16 operand in the quantizer coordinates (the W16A16 arm); statistics of z only
d1.statistics: per (Linear, shape, call): |z|^2, |z-z_prev|^2, mean over tokens of amax|z-z_prev|/amax|z|, A4 RTN residual dot with previous call's residual; groups video all/frame0/future, action all/first10/rest

evaluation.aggregation: seed -> context -> suite -> equal four-suite mean
evaluation.teacher: cached BF16 heldout teacher, 0 new teacher queries

reference_h_w16a4.source: fastwam-vq-r128-joint-c8 H_W16A4 (RotationBanks, zero rotations), reused by fastwam-r128-improvements

decision.d1: go if, over video-loop and action-loop keys and steps 1..9, median innovation ratio sqrt(|z-z_prev|^2/|z|^2) < 0.5 or median adjacent-step A4 residual correlation > 0.5
decision.d3: go if the best of A4_sd / A4_inno / A4_inno_sd / A4_inno_sd05 closes >= 50% of the A4->A8 gap on both first10 motor RMSE and future NMSE, and is below A4_g32 on both
decision.mechanism: A4_dither below A4 on future NMSE indicates coherent cross-step accumulation of RTN error

scope: fixed-input held-out accuracy of activation quantizers with BF16 weights; fake quantization in eager PyTorch; no kernel, speed or closed-loop claim
